parsed.name: A2D源测电源板
parsed.description: 这是一块可编程电源与测量一体化电路板，可输出设定电压或电流，并测量电压、电流及板载温度。它适合实验室中用于为被测器件供电、进行基础电学表征、校准与板级调试。
parsed.description_en: This is a programmable power and measurement board that can source a set voltage or current and measure voltage, current, and onboard temperature. It is suitable for laboratory use in powering devices under test, basic electrical characterization, calibration, and board-level debugging.
